title: a new test skip with no condition
how: in test code: describe / it / test / suite .skip( , or skip: true / skip: 'a reason' (a literal, not a condition)

explain.what: A test is skipped with no condition: test.skip, describe.skip, skip: true or skip: 'a reason'.
explain.why: A skipped test checks nothing, but the suite still looks green. Nobody notices when the code it covered breaks.
explain.fix: Fix the test, or delete it if it no longer applies. If it must skip on some machines, make skip a condition (for example the platform).
